description: Two-hander and a blood price - brands everything and drinks its way back up.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from data/reference/coa/witch-hunter.json (38 real CoA Black Knight talents, role DPS, playing as an off-tank). Replaces a 23-node tree with 2 procs and 20 bare numbers. Fourth and last Witch Hunter spec: the class went from 6 procs across 92 nodes to 44 across 114. Half of CoA's talents here are gated on wielding a two-handed weapon and this engine has no 'while wielding X' condition, so those apply unconditionally. Every CoA reference to Rage is translated to Focus.

nodes.name: Shadow Brand
nodes.description: Your ability damage brands the target, burning it with shadow for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Direct ability damage now applies Shadow Brand to enemies. Shadow Brand: Marks the target for 12 seconds, dealing High Threat Shadow Damage over 12 seconds.' 12 sec is 4 turns. This is the mark three other nodes in the tree read, and the old tree had no form of it. 'High Threat' is not a property a dot carries here - threat_generation_pct is a character stat - so the threat half is lost.

nodes.name: Dark Penance
nodes.description: Increases your Agility by up to 4% and your parry and dodge by up to 4%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Agility and your chance to parry and dodge by 2%.' Authored as the full-investment ceiling at one rank and left to the rank policy. agility_pct takes percentage POINTS; parry and dodge are read raw.

nodes.name: Dusk Knight
nodes.description: Increases your parry by 40% of your Agility and your dodge by 25% of your Intellect.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Level 20 Passive. Increases your parry rating by 40% of your Agility and your dodge rating by 25% of your Intellect.' Both pairings are live - parry and dodge are in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, agility and intellect are sources. Conversions are FRACTIONS. This is the third Witch Hunter node that makes Intellect matter on a physical kit, after Boltslinger's Arbalist and Houndmaster's Dark Mind.

nodes.name: Dark Power
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 30 Passive. You now gain 1 Stamina for every 2 Agility.' NOT buildable as the conversion it is. STAMINA IS NOT A CONVERSION TARGET - STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS holds attack_power, ranged_ap, spell_power, healing_power, armor, block_value, parry, dodge, haste and the two crit chances, and nothing else - so stamina_from_agility_pct is skipped in silence by character.py, the Clarity of the Heavens failure recorded in that dict's own comment. Authored that way first and the audit caught it. Rebuilt as a flat Stamina percentage, which is what the conversion was for on a spec that stacks Agility anyway. stamina_pct takes percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Dark Chivalry
nodes.description: Increases your armor by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Armor contribution from mail items by 100%.' There is no per-armour-type scaling in this engine - armour is one number by the time a talent sees it - so the mail condition is dropped and 100% cut to 20%, since it now applies to every piece rather than to one armour class. armor_pct takes percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Grasp of the Undying
nodes.description: Your weapon swings have a 25% chance to leech 20% of the damage back as health.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Level 10 Passive. Auto attacks while wielding a two-handed weapon now have a 25% chance to unleash Grasp of the Undying, leeching health from the target.' The two-handed gate is dropped - no 'while wielding X' condition exists. leech_pct without smart:true heals the carrier, which is what this is for; with it, the heal would go to the worst-off ALLY instead, which is a different talent. Also carries CoA's Shadowy Tendrils ('strikes 2 additional nearby enemies'), which no key can add.

nodes.name: Shadow Order
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shadow Brand by up to 40% and the damage of your damage-over-time effects by up to 10%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Shadow Brand by 20% and your hit rating by 3% of your Agility.' The hit conversion is NOT built: hit_rating is not in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, so hit_rating_from_agility_pct would be skipped in silence - the Clarity of the Heavens failure. Replaced with dot_damage, which raises the brand the same way and is live. Note the brand applied by this tree's tier 0 node is a proc-applied dot and is NOT affected by ability_witch_hunter_shadow_brand_damage, which keys off the ABILITY of that id - both exist, so the key is not dead, but it reaches the cast version only.

nodes.name: Dark Riposte
nodes.description: Parrying an attack restores health and 10 Focus.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim but for the resource: 'Parrying enemy attacks now restores 5% of your missing health and Rage.' Rage -> Focus. '5% of missing health' is not a payload shape - heal_flat is a number and there is no percentage-of-missing form - so it is a flat 60. on_parry is a live trigger this class otherwise never uses, and the whole avoidance half of the spec hangs off it.

nodes.name: No Regrets
nodes.description: March of the Black King hardens you, increasing your armor by 15% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your March of the Black King now increases your Armor by 15%.' on_cast rather than on_damage_cast: March of the Black King is restore_resource and deals no damage, so a damage trigger would never have fired on it - the same trap Coordinated Killing avoided in Houndmaster.

nodes.name: Secret Society
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow spell damage by up to 8% and your spell critical strike chance by up to 8%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Shadow critical strike chance and Shadow damage dealt by 4% and your expertise by 5.' 'expertise' is read by no engine code, so that half is dropped - third time in this rebuild. Crit chance is not school-specific here, so the Shadow restriction survives only on the damage half. shadow_spell_damage is a <school>_spell_damage key the engine builds by interpolation.

nodes.name: Noctis Protection
nodes.description: Noctis Blade shields you for 60% of the damage it deals.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Noctis Blade now applies a shield absorbing 266 + 200% Stamina + 10% AP damage for 4 seconds.' shield_pct sizes the absorb from the TRIGGERING amount rather than from a stat formula, which is the only form the payload has - so it is 60% of the hit instead of a Stamina-scaled number. 4 sec is 2 turns. Noctis Blade already heals for half its damage, so this makes it the spec's whole defensive turn.

nodes.name: Wide Swings
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Noctis Blade by 10.8%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Noctis Blade and Grasp of the Undying by 20% on enemies affected by Shadow Brand.' No effect key reads whether the target carries a debuff, so the condition is dropped; CoA's 20% is kept because Shadow Brand is on everything anyway once tier 0 is taken. Grasp of the Undying is a proc rather than an ability, so there is no ability_*_damage key for it.

nodes.name: Wicked Intent
nodes.description: Desecrate has a 15% chance to make Noctis Blade ready again at once.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Desecrate now has a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Noctis Blade.' Ports directly.

nodes.name: Dark Juggernaut
nodes.description: Desecrate restores health.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Desecrate now restores health plus an additional 1% maximum health for each target struck affected by Shadow Brand.' Nothing counts how many targets a cast hit, and nothing reads how many of them carry a debuff, so the per-target scaling is dropped and the base heal kept as a flat amount.

nodes.name: Calm Under Pressure
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Stoicism by 40% and Burrow Bolt by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Stoicism by -30 sec and Burrow Bolt by -5 sec.' Both expressed as percentages because cooldowns are counted in turns here. POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Witch Knight
nodes.description: Your ability damage grants Witching, increasing your haste by 10% and your magic resistance for 3 turns, stacking 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct ability damage with a two-handed weapon now reduces the remaining cooldown of your Tonics by 1 sec and grants Witching. Witching: Increases magic resistances by 10%, and melee haste by 10% for 8 sec, stacking 3 times.' The two-handed gate is dropped. The Tonic cooldown rider is dropped too: a proc can reset_cooldown, but doing that AND applying a stacking buff off one trigger would make this node the whole tier. CoA's numbers and 3 stacks kept; 8 sec is 3 turns.

nodes.name: Shadowstorm
nodes.description: Pommel Smash has a 20% chance to leech 35% of its damage back as health.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Pommel Smash now has a 20% chance to trigger a Shadowstorm. Shadowstorm: Leeches health from enemies within 8 yds.' The radius is gone; the leech is the talent. CoA's 20% kept.

nodes.name: Bulwark of Darkness
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Dawn Blade by 13.5%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Dawn Blade is now increased by 5% for each stack of Pommel Smash on the target.' Pommel Smash leaves no stacks in Frontier, and nothing reads another effect's stack count in any case, so the per-stack scaling is dropped and priced as a flat 25% - five stacks' worth of CoA's bonus.

nodes.name: Dark Barrier
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Stoicism by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Stoicism by 5 sec.' 5 sec is under 2 turns, rounded up since 1 would be less than CoA's. NOTE this node is deliberately left OUT of the rank policy's reach by carrying a small integer effect - a duration cannot be divided across ranks, so tools/talent_ranks.rankable() refuses it. See that function for why: re-ranking a +1 turn node multiplied the ceiling instead of splitting it.

nodes.name: Undying
nodes.description: Dawn Blade sharpens your next Noctis Blade, increasing its critical strike chance by 40% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While below 75% maximum health, Dawn Blade now increases the critical strike chance of Noctis Blade by 40% for 10 seconds.' Two losses. No proc payload reads the carrier's own health, so the below-75% gate is dropped. And a status effect cannot carry ability_witch_hunter_noctis_blade_crit, because per-ability keys are read through get_talent_effects() which never includes status effects - so the 40% is general physical crit for the window instead of Noctis-only. CoA's number and 10 sec (3 turns) kept.

nodes.name: Clinch Fighting
nodes.description: Taking a heavy blow steadies you, healing you and increasing the damage of Noctis Blade by 50% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Attacks which would otherwise kill you now heal you for 50% maximum health and increases the damage of Noctis Blade by 50% for 6 seconds. Can only occur once every 2 min.' A cheat-death trigger does not exist - no proc reads 'this hit would have killed me' - so it is a 10% chance on taking damage with an 8-turn internal cooldown, which is roughly CoA's once-every-2-minutes. The damage half is general rather than Noctis-only for the same status-effect reason as Undying, and is halved to 25% because it now applies to everything.

nodes.name: Guardbreaker
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Pommel Smash by up to 21.6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Your Pommel Smash now strikes an additional nearby enemy.' No key adds a target to an ability, so this is repriced as damage - the same call as Boltslinger's Relentless, and made the same way rather than authoring an aoe_damage bonus that would apply to nothing (pommel_smash is single-target).

nodes.name: Foresight
nodes.description: Your critical strikes restore 12 Focus.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your direct Physical critical strikes now grant allies Replenishment. In addition, Dawn Blade is now guaranteed to critically strike against Undead or Demons. Replenishment: Replenishes 5% of maximum mana per 5 sec for 15 seconds.' There is no mechanism that grants ALLIES a resource effect from a proc - grant_resource pays the carrier - and no key reads creature type, so both halves land on the Witch Hunter as Focus. 1-turn internal cooldown so a crit streak does not refill the bar.

nodes.name: Night King
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Noctis Blade by 27%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Noctis Blade now consumes Shadow Brand to deal 50% increased damage.' THE CONSUME IS THE ONE REAL LOSS IN THIS TREE. Consuming a target's stacks is a live mechanism - consumes_target_stacks_of, which Starcaller's whole class is built on - but it is a property of the ABILITY, set in data/abilities/, and no talent effect switches it on. Tinker's Drone Striker hit the identical wall and is documented there. So the 50% is granted flat and the description does not promise a consume that will not happen.

nodes.name: Blade of the Misbegotten
nodes.description: Dawn Blade feeds you, increasing your maximum health by 5% per stack for 3 turns, stacking 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Dawn Blade now increases your health by 15% of the damage dealt for 8 seconds, stacking 3 times.' A status effect cannot size itself from the triggering amount unless the payload does it (shield_pct and leech_pct can; apply_effect cannot), so the gain is a percentage of max health instead of a percentage of the hit. CoA's 3 stacks and 8 sec (3 turns) kept. max_health_pct takes percentage POINTS inside a status effect, so 5.0 - authored 0.05 first, which is 0.05% and would have been a node that did visibly nothing. The audit caught it; a status stat_mod of 0.05 is perfectly valid and simply too small to notice in play, which is the worst kind of wrong.

nodes.name: Destroyer of Evil
nodes.description: Dawn Blade leaves the target burning with twilight for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Dawn Blade now deals an additional 20% of the damage dealt as Twilight Damage every 1 sec for 3 seconds.' Twilight is not one of this engine's six schools (arcane, fire, frost, nature, shadow, holy), so it is shadow - the half of CoA's Twilight this spec is built on. A proc-applied dot takes a flat potency, so 20% of a Dawn Blade is approximated at 30 a turn.

nodes.name: Dawn Knight
nodes.description: Avoiding an attack has a 40% chance to make your next hits 25% stronger for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 50 Passive. Avoiding damage or dealing damage with auto attacks now has a 40% chance to grant you Dawn Knight. Dawn Knight: Your next Dawn Blade within 15 seconds is free of cost and deals 25% increased damage.' Built on the AVOID half only - one proc, one trigger, and avoidance is this spec's theme. Making a cast free is not reachable from a status effect (cost keys go through get_talent_effects()), and the 25% applies generally rather than to Dawn Blade alone for the same reason. CoA's 40% and 15 sec (3 turns) kept.

nodes.name: Gaze of the Black Knight
nodes.description: Your ability damage wraps you in a shield absorbing 40% of it, and your critical strikes make you 15% harder to hurt for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: '3 min cooldown. Apply a dark shield to yourself, absorbing damage and then gaze upon your party members, causing 25% of the damage they take to be transferred to you for 12 sec.' The TRANSFER is not buildable at all: nothing in this engine redirects damage from one character to another, and inventing it from a talent is not a thing a payload can do. So the capstone keeps the half that works - the absorb - and pairs it with Dark Oath, which CoA attaches to Knight's Seal ('reducing all damage taken by -20% for 8 seconds'), because a capstone that only absorbed would read as a weaker Noctis Protection. damage_taken_pct is read RAW in a status effect, so -0.15 is -15%; the physical_ and magic_ variants beside it would be -15.0, and getting that backwards is a 1500% reduction - which is exactly what Boltslinger's Evasive shipped as before the audit caught it.
